needed.evidence: A narrow sidewalk under 1m wide, partially obstructed and with trip hazards
needed.suggestion: Install a fully usable sidewalk at least 1.5 metres wide along the left side of the road from the evident obstruction to the crossing.

needed.evidence: Sidewalk under 1.5 metres with parked cars and other obstructions
needed.suggestion: Remove obstructions and extend the sidewalk on the right side to at least 1.5 metres width.
Resurface and smooth the footway on both sides to eliminate trip hazards.

needed.evidence: Crossing is difficult to see and lacks proper kerb ramps
needed.suggestion: Install a refuge island and implement visible road markings to aid pedestrian crossing visibility and safety.

needed.evidence: Signalised crossing on a road with 4 or more lanes without a refuge
needed.suggestion: Add a refuge island to split the crossing on this wide road, improving pedestrian safety.
